
# Define Functions
```{r}
se <- function (x) {sd (x,na.rm =TRUE) / sqrt (length(na.exclude (x)))}

fun_hal <- function (x) {(x - (-286.8851)) / 65.1187}
fun_hol <- function (x) {(x - 284.2803) / 422.3727}
fun_hac <- function (x) {(x - 249.5578) / 839.3971}
```

```{r}
fun_process_data <- function(dat) {  # this function wrangles data coming from the online software
  
  dat |>
    filter(!grepl("(B1|B2)$", Sample)) |>  # remove blanks
    mutate(
      area = ifelse(is.na(Area), 0, Area)  # set NA (=not detected) as 0
    ) |>
    select(  # exclude two unnecessary columns
      -Qualifier_Status,
      -Qualifier_Message
    ) |>
    separate(  # separate the column Sample into columns date, segment, iteration
      col = Sample,
      into = c("date", "segment", "iteration"),
      sep = "_"
    ) |>
    mutate(  # convert iteration to minutes -> one iteration lasts 45 mins, every segment takes 15 mins to measure, so we average the time
      iteration = as.numeric(iteration),
      time_min = iteration * 45 - 22,
      quant = ifelse(
        Compound == "HAL", fun_hal(area),
        ifelse(
          Compound == "HOL", fun_hol(area),
          ifelse(Compound == "HAC", fun_hac(area), area)
        )
      ),
      quant = ifelse(area == 0, 0, quant)
    )
}
```

## Plot
```{r}
# plot combined dat:

pal1 <- c("#ffb703","#8ecae6", "#fd9e02","#219ebc",
          "#fb8500", "#126782")

dat_all <- dat_all |>
  mutate(date = as.factor(date),
         segment = as.factor(segment),
         iteration = as.factor(iteration),
         Compound = as.factor(Compound),
         genotype = as.factor(genotype))

dat_plot <- dat_all |>
  group_by(segment, iteration, Compound, genotype) |>
  mutate(mean_a = mean(quant),
         se_a = se(quant)) |>
  ungroup()

neworder <- c("HAL","HOL","HAC", "DMNT", "Linalool")
dat_plot1 <- arrange(mutate(dat_plot,
             compound = factor(Compound,levels=neworder)),Compound)

dat_plot2 <- dat_plot1 |>
  unite(col = "seg_gen",
        c(segment, genotype),
        remove = F)

dat_plot2 <- subset(dat_plot2, !is.na(iteration))


plot5 <- ggplot(dat_plot2, aes(x = time_min, y = mean_a, fill = seg_gen, color = seg_gen)) +
  facet_wrap(~ compound, scales = "free_y") +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_a-se_a, ymax= mean_a + se_a), width=0) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_a - se_a, 
		    ymax = mean_a + se_a),
		    alpha = 0.3,
		    colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal1) +
  # scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-5,65), expand = c(0,0), 
  #                    breaks=seq(0,60,15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal1) +
   theme(text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black'),
        title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "time (min)", y = "area")

plot5
```

```{r}
# Maximum y-axis values for S1, S2, S3
y_limits <- list(
  HAL     = c(250, 500, 250),
  HOL     = c(40, 80, 40),
  HAC     = c(2.5, 5, 2.5),
  DMNT    = c(1000, 1000, 2000),
  Linalool = c(350, 350, 700)
)

# Make sure segments are in the desired order
dat_plot2 <- dat_plot2 |>
  mutate(
    segment = factor(segment, levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3"))
  )

plots <- list()

for (comp in unique(dat_plot2$compound)) {
  
  dat <- dat_plot2 |>
    filter(compound == comp)
  
  # Get y-axis limits for this compound
  ylim <- y_limits[[comp]]
  
  plots[[comp]] <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = time_min,
      y = mean_a,
      fill = genotype,
      color = genotype
    )
  ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ segment,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
      y = list(
        segment == "S1" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ylim[1])),
        segment == "S2" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ylim[2])),
        segment == "S3" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ylim[3]))
      )
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_a - se_a,
        ymax = mean_a + se_a
      ),
      alpha = 0.3,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal1) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = "white"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      title = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "time (min)",
      y = "area",
      title = comp
    )
}
```

```{r}
# barplots total sum:

dat_plot3 <- dat_plot2 |>
  group_by(date, segment, genotype, compound) |>
  summarize(
    sum_volatile = case_when(
      first(compound) %in% c("DMNT", "Linalool") ~ sum(area, na.rm = TRUE),
      TRUE ~ sum(quant, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )




# Calculate mean and SE
dat_summary <- dat_plot3 |>
  group_by(compound, segment, genotype) |>
  mutate(
    mean_volatile = mean(sum_volatile, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_volatile = se(sum_volatile))

# One plot per compound
plots <- list()

for (comp in unique(dat_summary$compound)) {
  
  dat <- dat_summary |>
    filter(compound == comp)
  
  plots[[comp]] <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = segment,
      y = mean_volatile,
      fill = genotype
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_volatile - se_volatile,
        ymax = mean_volatile + se_volatile
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    labs(
      title = comp,
      x = "Segment",
      y = "Sum volatile",
      fill = "Genotype"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

sum_hac <- plots$HAC
```

# Stats

```{r}

model <- lm(sqrt(sum_volatile) ~ compound * segment * genotype, data = dat_plot3)

ggqqplot(rstandard(model))

summary(rstandard(model))
sd(rstandard(model), na.rm = TRUE)

hist(dat_all$quant)
ggqqplot(dat_all, "quant",
         color = c("Compound", "segment", "genotype"),
         merge = T)


anova(model)
summary(model)

qqnorm(rstandard(model))
qqline(rstandard(model))

hist(rstandard(model), breaks = 30)

ggplot(
  data.frame(
    fitted = fitted(model),
    residual = rstandard(model)
  ),
  aes(x = fitted, y = residual)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(
  dat_plot3,
  aes(x = fitted(model), y = rstandard(model))
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ compound, scales = "free") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
SRH_results <- lapply(unique(dat_plot3$compound), function(cmp) {
  
  dat_tmp <- dat_plot3 |>
    filter(compound == cmp) |>
    mutate(
      segment = as.factor(segment),
      genotype = as.factor(genotype)
    ) |>
    droplevels()
  
  scheirerRayHare(
    sum_volatile ~ segment * genotype,
    data = dat_tmp
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect") |>
    mutate(compound = cmp, .before = 1)
  
}) |>
  bind_rows()

SRH_results
```

```{r}
# art
library(dplyr)
library(ARTool)
library(tibble)

ART_results <- lapply(unique(dat_plot3$compound), function(cmp) {
  
  dat_tmp <- dat_plot3 |>
    filter(compound == cmp) |>
    mutate(
      segment = as.factor(segment),
      genotype = as.factor(genotype)
    ) |>
    droplevels()
  
  art_model <- art(
    sum_volatile ~ segment * genotype,
    data = dat_tmp
  )
  
  anova(art_model) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("Effect") |>
    mutate(compound = cmp, .before = 1)
  
}) |>
  bind_rows()

ART_results
```
